from pathlib import Path
Path('README.md').write_text('''# Kairos V5 Physical-Control Prototype

Kairos tests whether experience deposited into a simulated physical medium can
support prediction, exploration and goal-directed action. The medium is a
numerical lattice implemented in TypeScript; the live body adapter is Minecraft.
The project does not establish human-like cognition or general autonomous learning.

## Current evidence — 2026-09-10

The latest recorded three-stage attempt completed "'`note 0 → 1 → 2` and failed to
reach `note=3`. The final prediction had no valid physical samples. Case B,
starting at `note=1`, has not run. The subsequent query optimization has targeted
coverage but no new live qualification.

- [Three-stage results and missing reproducibility assets](docs/three-stage-test-status-2026-09-10.md)
- [Earlier single-goal demonstration and its limits](docs/prototype-demonstration-v1.md)
- [First-principles review, deletions and validation](docs/first-principles-review-2026-09-10.md)

Raw Minecraft evidence, experience checkpoints, server binaries and worlds are
not included. A fresh clone can run source tests; reproducing the live results
requires those separately verified assets. No successful new live run is claimed
by this cleanup.

## One current memory path

1. A trusted, complete action or passive observation window deposits an R1
   experience and its physical trace. Censored windows remain auditable.
2. R2 joins at least two R1 atoms only when real public continuity is established.
   Reset, gaps and external takeover break continuity.
3. R2A measures repeated ordered patterns, current applicability and registered
   intervention evidence. R3 is a transient query against the current observation.
4. Read-only prediction and the control workspace propose one body action. Real
   feedback invalidates stale predictions; goal completion needs later observation.

The control field uses fixed drive weights and a stochastic competition law.
These are design assumptions, not learned human decision principles. Twenty-four
simulation seeds measure model behavior, not twenty-four independent real-world
confirmations. Missing or ambiguous readouts remain unknown.

`src/prototype.ts` exposes the environment-neutral memory, prediction, goal and
control interfaces. `src/adapters/minecraft/` exposes the body, live runtime and
viewers used by `src/main.ts`. A different environment can implement
`PhysicalControlEnvironmentV2`.

## Deleted architectures

The point/page `PhysicalMemory`, the earlier `HierarchicalPhysicalMemoryV1`, their
exclusive learners, runners and tests have been removed. The unused meta-authority
scheduler, count-only meta-prediction grades and R-series checkpoint wrapper have
also been removed. The real runtime no longer saves a retired checkpoint format
just to accommodate an old test double.

Historical implementations and their documentation remain reproducible from the
[pre-cleanup commit](https://github.com/vasily-tolkyov/kairos-v5-predictive-agent/tree/7fe4157dcac57daf9febf5f0d449ea938a081249).
Older dated documents describe that source state; their commands and source paths
are not current entry points. No raw experiment evidence was deleted. The
remaining regression tests exercise the retained implementation and contracts.

## Checkpoints

| Component | Canonical identity |
| --- | --- |
| Runtime pointer | `KairosV5DistributedPhysicalRuntimeV1` |
| Default memory | `KairosV5DistributedPhysicalMemoryV3` |
| Memory semantics | `distributed-R1-attractor_R2-site-fibre-continuity_R2A-physical-branch-field_R3-transient-current-input` |
| Public context | `V5PublicRelativeLayoutV1` |
| Configuration | `KairosV5PhysicalControlConfigV2` |

V3 remains the default. Explicit timescale runs use
`KairosV5DistributedPhysicalMemoryV4` with the exact timescale-law identity.
V3/V4 reject cross-version overwrite and retain separate restore paths. The
current memory schema, physical laws and prediction thresholds are unchanged by
this cleanup. Existing dictionary, intervention and internal-channel audit state
remain part of their original checkpoints; the wrapper was not the production
persistence format.

The attractor dictionary and intervention agenda expose experimental recording
APIs. Their existence does not mean the controller autonomously designs and
executes a complete intervention curriculum. Internal-channel episode counts are
audit data and no longer receive a predictive-stability grade.

## Build and verify

Node.js 24 or later is required.

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:prototype
npm run test:minecraft
```

Build removes generated `dist/` first, so deleted source/tests cannot survive as
stale executable output. `test:prototype` selects files without the `minecraft-`
prefix; `test:minecraft` selects that prefix. These are file groups, not a claim
that every prototype test is independent of adapter utilities. Full distributed
integration diagnostics are opt-in where their tests say so.

## Live entry points

With the required Minecraft assets configured:

```sh
npm start -- --bootstrap-only
npm run minecraft:basic-action-loop-v1
npm start -- --experience-pointer /absolute/path/EXPERIENCE_LATEST.json
```

The basic action loop prepares an isolated fixture and permits at most 16 harmless
body actions. It does not initialize or write long-term memory, so it is an
exploration/body demonstration, not an end-to-end continual-learning result.
Grounded-goal demonstrations and their explicit parameters are documented in the
[single-goal report](docs/prototype-demonstration-v1.md).

The optional first-person viewer uses port 3000; the read-only dashboard uses
port 3002. `/state` returns bounded summaries. Full media is available only through
explicit revision-pinned pages. Checkpoint serialization runs in the compute
worker, streams to disk and commits the pointer after the snapshot and habits.
Large snapshots use the existing segmented format. `--profile lean`,
`--snapshot-interval` and the stall watchdog affect auxiliary runtime operation;
they do not qualify new agent capabilities.
'"''')

# Kairos — Experience-Driven Control Prototype

Kairos learns predictions from executed sensor/motor windows, explores through
novelty and prediction error, and searches its learned model for multi-stage
goals. The current core is a small simulated rate-neuron medium implemented in
TypeScript. It has no supplied precondition rules, effect clauses or action

## Current evidence — 2026-09-10

The current public API passed three randomized motor/receptor assignments across
continuous **A → B → A** mechanism changes, without resetting learned memory:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Autonomous acquisition | 36,864 individually selected actions |
| One- to four-action goals, including conjunctions | **252/252 verified** |
| Independent state/action prediction checks | **2,880/2,880 correct** |
| Checks using initial combinations withheld from training | **360/360 correct** |
| Unreachable goals | **9/9 returned unknown**, no body actions |
| Read-only evaluation and checkpoint restore | **9/9 unchanged** |

Of the 2,880 state predictions, 2,832 met the execution confidence gate; the
remaining 48 stayed ineligible despite predicting the correct state. All 252
goal runs used eligible predictions, fresh replanning after each action and
later public observations to verify completion. The task generator supplies
world consequences only; the agent receives no phase label or solution.

Frozen learning failed after each mechanism change; new experience restored
success. Clearing learned connections or removing the motor input prevented
executable predictions. Additional regressions cover nonlinear XOR/XNOR
learning, retaining an unrehearsed motor capability, numeric three-stage goals,
corrupt feedback, persistence and delayed goal verification.

See [the full assessment and remaining limits](docs/experience-capability-evaluation-2026-09-10.md)
and [machine-readable results](docs/experience-capability-results-2026-09-10.json).

## The smaller core

- "'`src/experience-medium.ts`: separate sensory, motor and result populations;
  learned direct and hidden connections; error-driven updates from actual
  outcomes; bounded replay; read-only prediction and versioned checkpoints.
- `src/experience-agent.ts`: novelty/error exploration and a bounded breadth-first
  search over predicted states. Only the first action is executed, followed by
  a fresh observation and new search. The default search depth is six actions.
- `src/prototype.ts`: the environment-neutral public API. Bodies implement
  `ExperienceEnvironment`; goals use public observable predicates.
- `src/adapters/minecraft/experience.ts`: the existing body'"'s public observations,
  available actions and real event receipts, with no server-command access.

The theory revision removes the old production dependency on three lattice
levels, unconditioned terminal attractors, registered intervention grades and
a separate control competition field. The earlier lattice associated conditions
with outcomes even without a motor input; successful terminal calibration did
not make conditioned prediction work. Its implementation and failure evidence
remain available for explicit legacy comparisons, outside the current public API.

A rate unit relaxes toward its learned drive, then applies "'`tanh`; separate
readout connections produce scores over actually observed values. Weights are
trained by gradient updates, including backpropagated hidden errors. This is an
engineering model of plasticity, not a claim of biological equivalence or a
literal hardware material. Scores and recent predictive accuracy are not a
calibrated probability of success.

## 从第一性原理删除的假设

首先检验旧模型，而不是把既有层级当作目标本身：

1. 去掉重复注入的行动前状态后，旧模型由两个稳定分支、零关系进展到四个稳定分支、四个关系。它确实存在输入和结果混叠。
2. 去掉 R1 的额外无条件吸引子要求，目标经验可以被召回。但八次匹配干预的完整条件选择率仍然都是零。
3. 直接测量发现，不输入行动也能产生接近的条件—结果场。终态自激稳定不能替代“当前条件下执行某动作”的前向预测。
4. 临时门控和移除集合共振也没有修复关键能力；相关实验被撤回，补丁及原始输出保留作失败对照。

因此，本轮从当前公开入口和默认执行路径移除了三层晶格、吸引子资格阶梯、外部干预登记和独立竞争控制场的依赖。旧实现保留为显式 legacy 比较及旧存档读取来源，当前 API 不再导出它们。

## 新理论与最小实现

保留的是可检验的闭环：**观测 → 自主选择动作 → 执行 → 结果 → 预测误差更新 → 用更新后的模型规划**。

感知、动作和结果使用不同的神经元群。动作选择一个电机输入通道；没有动作输入就没有可执行预测。连接权重只由完整、实际执行的观测窗口修改，结果不会作为预测输入注入。

隐藏单元使用膜电位松弛 `du/dt = drive − u` 和 `tanh` 响应。直接连接与隐藏连接共同预测各感知通道实际见过的值。误差通过梯度与反向传播更新连接；每个动作保留最多 64 个回放样本。所有连接都是从经验学习的，没有预填的保持、切换、开门、设定条件或目标路径规则。

模型输出是未校准的读出分数。执行要求膜电位收敛、至少 16 次实际观测、更新前测得的近期整状态预测准确率不低于 0.9、读出胜出差不低于 0.8。这些是公开的工程门槛，不是因果证明或成功概率。

探索由经验覆盖不足和预测误差驱动；规划以同一个前向模型作有限广度优先搜索，默认最多六步、512 个展开节点。每次只执行第一步，收到反馈后重新搜索。相对目标的基准固定在接收目标时，避免“增加 3”在每次重规划时向后移动。目标确认需要至少五个后续观测序号，允许预算用完后继续观测。

## 因果与必要性对照

- 三次未学习的冷启动均不能规划成功。
- 六次机制改变后，冻结学习的旧模型都耗尽动作预算；随后继续学习的模型全部通过。
- 九份模型清除学习连接后，目标均返回未知。
- 九份模型去掉电机输入后，均不能给出可执行预测。
- 评估过程中学习关闭；模型存档前后哈希一致。恢复后的下一次学习也保留相同回放随机状态和参数结果。
- 非线性 XOR→XNOR 的机制切换、另一动作学习后的无复习保留、数值多阶段控制、反馈断帧、非真实来源、重复事件冲突、损坏参数和迟延确认均有自动回归。

这些对照证明本测试中的成功依赖实际学习到的连接与行动输入。它们不把预测正确率升级为普遍的因果识别能力。
